payload.summary: Refined the roadmap scaffold for sandboxed-flow ri-01 into a full plan: native Bash sandbox in project settings, outward commands excluded, allow list reduced to non-readers, a probe for host verification.
completed_work: proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, spec delta under harness-engineering, contracts stub, work-packages.yaml
Discovery questions and both approval gates not asked: item pre-approved in the roadmap and dispatched by autopilot-roadmap; assumptions listed in proposal.md

decisions.title: Sandbox configuration ships in project-shared settings
decisions.rationale: Versioned, identical on both hosts and in every worktree, testable from the repository.

decisions.title: Git hosts stay off the sandbox network allowlist; push, fetch, pull, gh, railway and docker are excluded commands
decisions.rationale: Outward actions are decided by the existing permission rules and cannot be reached from inside the sandbox by wrapping the command.

decisions.title: The allow list grants no general reader or interpreter
decisions.rationale: Such a rule approves the same command when retried outside the sandbox, which bypasses denyRead.

decisions.title: failIfUnavailable is not set
decisions.rationale: Hosts without prerequisites and cloud sessions fall back to permission rules; with the reduced allow list the fallback prompts.
